csv_project_name: AE for Parkway Drive and SR 99 Pedestrian Bridge
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Fresno s Department of Transportation/Fresno Area Express (hereafter referred to as FAX), seeks a professional consultant to provide Architectural and Engineering (A&E) services for the Reconnecting Communities Project. The Project is funded through a Reconnecting Communities Grant and will include planning and preliminary design activities for the areas around the landing pads of a planned pedestrian bridge that will cross California State Route 99. The bridge will connect Parkway Drive and Roeding Park. The project will focus on enhancing the pedestrian experience and expanding transportation options for residents.
